summary: Verified UI-only enhancements: (1) assignment_prompt backend passthrough + Teacher Setup optional field, (2) persistent assignment-prompt box in Student Workspace, (3) Development Panel Teacher/Research view toggle. All 4 backend pytest checks pass. Full frontend flow verified end-to-end via ?dev preset with a completed AI turn (LLM ~55-65s). No regressions in durable-processing / intervention.focus / scaffolding_control / integration_calibration.applies.
notes_for_main_agent: MINOR (not a bug per spec, but worth surfacing): the LLM engine still outputs internal framework names (e.g. 'Reader Construction', 'Central Claim / Thesis') inside the *data* it produces for integration_calibration.primary_framework and .supporting_frameworks. In Teacher view the ACCORDION TITLES and BADGE LABELS are correctly relabeled (via FW_TEACHER + STATUS_META.tlabel), but the raw KV row 'Also considered:' still shows the model's own internal-name strings verbatim (e.g. '> Reader Construction'). The review request framed this as UI-labels-only, so this is out of scope for this phase — flagging it in case teacher-facing polish later wants to map those data values through FW_TEACHER too.

teacher_setup: Assignment Prompt field renders (data-testid='input-assignment_prompt') between Assignment and Pedagogical Purpose, multiline textarea
No required '*' on Assignment Prompt or Teacher Notes labels; asterisk is present on the other three
Form submits with all 3 required fields even when assignment_prompt is empty
Begin button disabled until required fields filled
workspace_prompt_box: data-testid='assignment-prompt' renders with label 'PROMPT — THE QUESTION YOU'RE ANSWERING' and preset prompt text
Visible before writing, remains visible after submitting a draft (across AI turn cycle)
backend_passthrough: POST /api/sessions with assignment_prompt stores and returns it on the session
Static-source assertion: 'assignment_prompt' is NOT referenced inside _build_prompt (engine input) — display-only
dev_panel_teacher_view_default: Framework accordions show teacher titles (What the Writing Is Trying to Do / Reader Understanding / How This Paragraph Works / Student Growth / etc.), NO (Mxx) tags
KV keys inside scaffolding-control-block: 'Focus this turn', 'Why this focus?', 'Postponed opportunities' present
Group headers 'Current Focus Area' and 'What the Coach Said' present
Status badges use teacher labels: Focus / Supporting / Postponed / In view / Not now
dev_panel_research_view: Clicking toggle switches text to 'Research view'
All 7 framework accordions show internal names with M-numbers (M6-M13)
accordion-toggle-detail ('Full engine internals') appears; expands with 'Current Telos' + candidate-invitation-0 populated
Status badges use internal labels: Primary / Supporting / Postponed / Applicable / Not applicable
toggle_reversibility: Toggling from Research back to Teacher view removes M-numbers, hides detail accordion, restores teacher labels
testids_unchanged: scaffolding-control-block, integration-calibration-block, intervention-block, selected-invitation, framework blocks, framework-status-* all resolve
regression: POST /interact returns immediately with a 'processing' turn (implicit — UI shows thinking dots then completes)
Accordion default-expansion behavior held (primary/supporting expanded, not_applicable collapsed)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py — SessionCreate + Session correctly add optional 'assignment_prompt' passthrough; create_session uses payload.model_dump() so the field flows through without modification. _build_prompt does not reference it, satisfying the display-only guarantee.

DevelopmentPanel.jsx — the t(teacher, research) helper cleanly routes every user-facing label; FW_TEACHER covers all 7 framework ids. STATUS_META has both label + tlabel keeping badges accessible in both views. Working Theory Detail is properly gated behind researchView.
TeacherSetup.jsx — asterisk exclusion is correct ('teacher_notes' AND 'assignment_prompt' skipped). 'ready' does not require assignment_prompt.

MINOR: FW_TEACHER map is used for accordion titles but not applied to the raw data-string values that the LLM emits inside integration_calibration.supporting_frameworks / .primary_framework. Result: strings like 'Reader Construction' can appear in the 'Also considered' KV row in Teacher view. Not a spec violation for this phase but a future polish opportunity.
seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral TEST_ sessions created during backend test (no cleanup needed; unique ids). One ?dev preset session created for UI testing (id logged: 3b517a85-2470-4e76-8821-72fdbd162c28).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_22 verified the UI-only teacher/research toggle + assignment_prompt passthrough. If future changes revisit the DevelopmentPanel, note that some LLM-emitted data strings (framework names in supporting_frameworks/primary_framework KVs) still contain internal M-terminology in Teacher view — main agent decided this is out of scope for now.
